what: Plan cannot classify no-action or refusal after a zero launcher exit
scenario_or_breakage: The helper contract says LAUNCHER_EXIT=0 emits class none, and run_ci_fix_vendor treats that as a winning tier before checks verify the fix; a cursor run that exits 0 but edits nothing or leaves CI failing bypasses the new first-fixer-non-health guard and burns outer attempts instead of taking the planned exit-3 path
suggested_fix: Add a post-launch verification guard for winning_tier=cursor when checks still fail or no actionable delta was produced, or remove no-action/refusal from the classifier contract until there is an implemented parser/verification path for them

what: BAIL_FAILURE_DETAIL_LOG is planned to point at the launcher capture rather than the CI failure log
scenario_or_breakage: The main-agent fix path may read cursor wrapper diagnostics such as timeout/refusal output without the failing test stack, so it can make a blind or wrong fix; the plan's mitigation to fetch fresh gh-run-logs is not part of the concrete Files-to-modify steps
suggested_fix: Persist a separate redacted CI log path, for example BAIL_CI_FAILURE_LOG=$gh_logs_capture_redacted when available, and make the Step 8+ special case explicitly run gh-run-logs.sh again when that path is absent or stale

what: Prompt-side Step 8 reads a state-supplied log path without a validation contract
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed or tampered ship-pr-state.sh could cause the orchestrator to read an arbitrary local file into the transcript while attempting the main-agent CI fix
suggested_fix: Before any Read of BAIL_FAILURE_DETAIL_LOG or new CI-log state, require an absolute regular non-symlink path resolved under IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, apply redaction/bounded reads, and ignore the state path if validation fails
